t: Chung Hwa Youths Group - New Body Formed

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No. ____
S.I., Special Branch, Previous
REPORT
Date September 22, 1937.
Subject Chun Hwa Youths Group (中華青年團) - new body formed.
Made by Clerk Liao Chung Chien. Forwarded by C. G____

A "Chun Hwa Youths Group" has recently come into existence with an office at S.I., Lane 276 Gordon Road. The principal object of this group is to promote "enemy-resistance" and national salvation activities. It has at present a membership of about forty persons, the majority of whom are students of various local schools. Members are required to donate contributions voluntarily to defray expenses for the maintenance of the group, but no membership fee is collected. The following is a list of the staff of the organization:-

Chief of the Group: Mr. Wei Ting Yi (衛鼎彝), a lecturer of the Great China University, Chung San Road, and a staff member of the Bureau of Social Affairs.

Vice Chief: Mr. Uong Lih Foo (翁立夫), a student of the Fuh Tan University, Kiangwan.

Chief of General Affairs Section: Mr. Tong Lin Yien (湯麟炎), a student of the Great China University, Chung San Road.

Chief of Organization Section: Mr. Ling Vung Hwa (林文華), a student of the Kwang Hwa University, Great Western Road.

The Group is at present making arrangements for the formation of a first-aid corps and a consolation corps. It has applied to the Kuomintang and other official organs for formal recognition of the organization.

Persons admitted to the Group are required to supply two photographs and pledge obedience to the orders of the organization.

日期：1937年9月22日。
事由：中华青年团——新成立的团体。
撰写人：职员廖仲坚（Liao Chung Chien）。转呈人：C. G____

“中华青年团”最近成立，办公地点位于戈登路276弄（S.I.）。该团体的主要宗旨是促进“抗敌”及救国活动。目前成员约四十人，其中大多数为本地各学校的学生。成员须自愿捐款以支付维持团体运作的费用，但不收取会费。以下是该组织职员名单：

团长：魏鼎彝先生，大夏大学（中山路）讲师，兼社会局职员。

副团长：翁立夫先生，复旦大学（江湾）学生。

总务科主任：汤麟炎先生，大夏大学（中山路）学生。

组织科主任：林文华先生，光华大学（大西路）学生。

该团体目前正在安排组建急救队和慰劳队。已向国民党及其他官方机构申请对该组织予以正式认可。

获准加入该团体者需提供两张照片，并宣誓服从该组织的命令。
